default_identity.r3_note: R3 predates the advisory index and commit-record evolution; strategies are compared, the footprint is reported as a delta, and the same-revision identity proof is default_c_matches_official_court

methodology.baseline_note: the comparator is the same backend without the WeftFS layer (A); the reference FUSE filesystem is not a comparator
methodology.host_contention: every repetition is published raw; if the host is shared with an external CPU/IO-heavy process, the median can include that process. The ledger uses the least-contended repetition and records both walls so the two are never conflated.
methodology.interleaving: the configuration order is rotated by one position per repetition so no configuration always occupies the same slot
methodology.repetition_profiles: every timed repetition enables the shipped phase collector; the attribution rep is repetition 1 and additionally emits per-tensor rows
methodology.wall_source: write child VmHWM/wall around the whole write phase, excluding the whole-fixture SHA-256 gate
